hicona.HiconaGraph#

class hicona.HiconaGraph(table, query=None)[source]#

Graph-tool Graph specialized for Hi-C data network analysis.

This class extends the graph_tool.Graph class, adding methods to facilitate the analysis of Hi-C data networks. All the methods from the parent class are still available and are not overwritten.

Parameters:
tableHiconaTable

Pixel table to create the graph from.

querystr, optional

Pandas-like query string to filter the pixel table. (Default is None)
